novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement hypothesis: beliefs encode “a recoverable ‘provenance’ direction partially orthogonal to the truth direction,” whose collapse tracks source-attribution errors and whose steering changes attributed source without changing truth-value. Searches around “parametric vs contextual knowledge hidden-state direction,” “context-memory conflict representation steering,” and “LLM knowledge source attribution probe” identify the closest work as SpARE, “Steering Knowledge Selection Behaviours in LLMs via SAE-Based Representation Engineering” (2024), which already detects internal context-memory conflict signals and steers which knowledge source controls an answer, alongside Marks and Tegmark’s “The Geometry of Truth” (2023) for linear truth directions. Moving from those results to an explicit source-tag representation, its geometry relative to truth, and collapse as an explanation of source misattribution is a substantive multi-step operationalization, but it remains a natural extension and combination of established truth probing and knowledge-source steering rather than a wholly new core paradigm.
